sources.title: Models - Docs - Kiro
sources.snippet: Models Kiro gives you access to frontier and open weight AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. GPT-5.6 brings OpenAI models to Kiro for the first time, with three tiers that balance agentic performance and cost. Pick the right model for the job, or select Auto to let Kiro route each task to the optimal model automatically.
